objective: maximize cumulative profit, buyer satisfaction and measurable funnel learning while preserving paid publication debt/floors

authoritativeState.rule: Aug 25 inventory is fully materialized in cloud state, but no current-day item counts until reader/buyer-visible strict verification. Missing sales/PV/CVR/acquisition/install values remain unknown.

allocationDecision.rank1: Consume and strict-verify the five enabled Aug 25 paid NOTE entries; do not count queue state or local publisher success.
allocationDecision.rank2: Consume and strict-verify the five enabled Aug 25 BOOTH entries; preserve buyer-visible title, price, downloadable-product and purchase-path checks.
allocationDecision.rank3: After paid-floor-critical items are moving, publish and strict-verify the two prepared free NOTE acquisition experiments; free output never substitutes for paid quota.
allocationDecision.rank4: Capture matched-age first-party note funnel, BOOTH sales and Microsoft Store acquisition/install metrics when accessible. Keep unavailable values null and do not infer winners.
allocationDecision.rank5: Continue CSV Cleaner & Duplicate Remover Microsoft Store submission prerequisites only after the Aug 25 paid publication floor is no longer at risk.
allocationDecision.rank6: Keep GitHub Pages limited to independently useful, attributable tools and links; no thin SEO mass production.

noteFunnel.freeCadence: 2/day experimental starting value; not a hard quota and not authorized to increase without comparable evidence
noteFunnel.ctaRule: one exact-intent paid CTA after standalone useful free content; only verified reader-visible paid URLs
noteFunnel.priceDecision: hold current prices until observed purchase/conversion evidence or a strong current market reason supports a controlled test

winnerAmplification.rule: A verified paid purchase is a strong promotion signal. Strong free response with weak paid conversion triggers CTA/theme-match/value-gap/price diagnosis before derivatives. Weak free+paid response after sufficient exposure triggers deprioritization.

microsoftStore.currentPriority: CSV Cleaner & Duplicate Remover submission completion
microsoftStore.nextAction: Complete every non-human submission prerequisite possible after paid-floor-critical work is safe; preserve highest-quality UI, stability, privacy, Store assets and testing gates; do not invent Store demand metrics.

githubPages.instruction: Use existing useful surfaces for attribution and context-matched verified outbound links. Build a new tool only when it has standalone utility and a measurable route into a relevant paid asset.

dataIntegrity: No winner, loser, conversion uplift, revenue, acquisition, install or retention claim without observed first-party evidence.
notificationPolicy: No user notification for this non-nightly cycle unless every profitable route is blocked by a proven human-only action. Daily consolidated report only at the designated nightly reporting cycle.
